records.title: Hu & Wang (2010) · Typical Ni–Cl–OH fullerene-like colloid synthesis
records.method: Source-described typical solvothermal procedure for colloidal fullerene-like nickel hydroxychloride. Charges and stages follow the main-text method; unavailable cooling, pressure, and workup details remain missing.

evidence_scope_notes: The 185 °C Figure 2 time series, main-text analytical context, and Figure 3 magnetic observation are separate evidence records. Figure 2 size narrative is not mapped to its timepoints; the Figure 3 sample has no recipe/batch join; none is asserted to be the same physical aliquot as the typical route.
